ranked.headline: Histology and language models predict spatial gene expression from tissue morphology
ranked.summary: Pathology foundation models and generative approaches now link H&E morphology with transcriptomic profiles at cohort and single-cell scale.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models infer single-cell gene regulatory networks from multi-omic data
ranked.summary: Paired scRNA and scATAC data and contrastive graph models now enable GRN inference that incorporates explicit biological priors.

ranked.headline: Generative and foundation models for omics integration, translation and fairness
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test whether multi-omics integration, generative models and foundation models actually improve omics prediction across populations.

ranked.headline: Disentangling regulatory, polygenic and transmission effects in human genomic variation
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale sequencing, case-parent trios and fine-grained expression data now allow separating biological effects from transmission and confounding.

ranked.headline: AI-guided closed loops couple molecular design and screening to predictive criteria
ranked.summary: Recent studies embed predictive models and active learning directly into iterative design loops, with validation by SPR and molecular dynamics.

ranked.headline: Pangenome and personalized references reshape somatic variant detection accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs alternative reference representations with error modeling to improve cancer variant and fusion detection.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict druggability, degradability and survival from molecular inputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply graph neural networks and self-supervised pretraining to genomic and structural prediction against established baselines.

ranked.headline: Variants linked to transcript regulation are prioritized using external evidence
ranked.summary: Recent work judges variant-to-expression predictions against GWAS concordance, clinical stage, and TWAS discovery rather than model fit alone.

ranked.headline: Upstream sequencing and analysis choices determine recovered bacterial genomic content
ranked.summary: Adaptive sampling, long-read pipelines and strain-resolved tools are maturing into integrated workflows linking sequencing to downstream inference.

ranked.headline: Held-out benchmarks reveal limits of biological foundation model generalization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair frozen-representation probes and held-out splits with benchmark reporting to test whether pretrained biological models generalize.

ranked.headline: Reference-anchored benchmarks test analytical pipelines before downstream inference
ranked.summary: Known-truth references now test omics and single-cell analytical choices before downstream biological conclusions are drawn.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models link DNA and RNA features to TF binding and expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply interpretable deep models to predict TF binding, splicing, and expression from sequence and structural inputs.

ranked.headline: Curated spatial and single-cell atlases standardize annotation for cross-study reuse
ranked.summary: Growing single-cell and spatial datasets are being packaged into harmonized, reusable resources with uniform processing and annotation.

ranked.headline: Analytic choices and statistical tests shape inferred structure in biological data
ranked.summary: Recent studies test how tool, parameter and test choices alter inferred diversity, alignment difficulty, microbial networks and epidemic forests.

ranked.headline: Standardized definitions guide quantity extraction from electrophysiology and imaging
ranked.summary: Explicit feature definitions and processing steps now ship as open, cross-platform software for analyzing large biological datasets.

ranked.headline: Fusing sequence, structure and graph features for multimodal interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal papers fuse sequence, structure, graph and text representations to predict protein and drug interactions and properties.

ranked.headline: Open-source Snakemake and Bioconductor tools expand genomic and epigenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent publications add reproducible workflows, LLM-based metadata extraction, and integrated databases to genomic and epigenomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned models assign graded functional scores to residues, paralogs, and GO terms
ranked.summary: Structure-based predictions are now paired with residue-level and family-specific scoring, with TAMALE producing graded proteome-wide outputs.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models gain kinetic constraints and growth-resolved validation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple enzyme, expression, and flux constraints to genome-scale models, validated against chemostat and 13C flux data.

ranked.headline: Sequence and phylogenetic methods packaged as performant, installable software
ranked.summary: Recent releases reimplement core sequence tools in Rust, C++ and Julia, emphasizing memory bounds, SIMD and parallel execution.

ranked.headline: Interpreting protein conformational ensembles beyond single static structures
ranked.summary: Ensemble predictors yield distinct conformational distributions, so model-derived dynamics require cautious interpretation.

ranked.headline: Flow and diffusion models generate ligands and biomolecules conditioned on structure
ranked.summary: Recent work extends structure-conditioned generative models to inference-time annealing, agentic design loops, and shallow-pocket benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Simulations link sequence, membrane and interface determinants to dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 papers and preprints apply MD and coarse-grained simulations to attribute conformational changes to defined perturbations.

ranked.headline: Tree-structured inference of hidden historical processes from phylogenies and lineage data
ranked.summary: New likelihood, polytope, and Neighbor-Joining methods extend phylogenetic inference of hidden historical processes from tree-structured data.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models dissect AD heterogeneity across MRI, connectome and transcriptome
ranked.summary: Individual-level attribution and normative-deviation frameworks now target tau pathways, MCI transitions and shared AD-PD grey-matter changes.

ranked.headline: Genome Architecture and Gene Duplication Shape Eukaryotic Evolution
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale and population-level genomes now resolve how duplication, selection, and structural change shape lineage-specific evolution.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks now resolve spatial domains and multi-omics gene features
ranked.summary: Recent graph learning methods across spatial transcriptomics and multi-omics report gains in domain identification, imputation, and driver gene prioritization.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models link chromatin openness and multi-omic inputs to gene regulation
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial omics methods now pair gene-level regulatory inference with explicit handling of technical variation and validation of their outputs.

ranked.headline: Predicted protein structures tested against independent experimental restraints
ranked.summary: Benchmarks on fuzzy complexes and cryo-EM maps now quantify agreement of predicted structures with NOE restraints and density-derived Cα positions.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for cryo-EM, cryo-ET, and serial-section EM image restoration
ranked.summary: Recent variational, prompt-based, and registration-guided methods address noise and distortion limits in electron microscopy image data.

ranked.headline: Compressed representations of repetitive genomic sequence support downstream analysis
ranked.summary: Two June 2026 publications address compressed and decomposed forms of repetitive genomic sequence for pangenome and repeat analysis.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models resolve single-cell diauxie, condensate dynamics, and morphogenesis
ranked.summary: Four recent items apply dynamical modeling frameworks to metabolic switching, condensates, microswimmers, and morphogenesis.

ranked.headline: Low-dimensional embeddings recover state structure in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: New embedding and validation methods target local structure, multiple candidate solutions, and stability in increasingly high-dimensional omics data.

ranked.headline: Barcode and indel errors drive long-read demultiplexing and recovery tool design
ranked.summary: Noisy long-read barcodes and indel errors now shape demultiplexing, variant recovery and simulation tools for ONT and PacBio data.

ranked.headline: Motif spacing, Pol II failure modes, and polyadenylation reshape transcriptional control
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication dissect how regulatory grammar, polymerase pausing and failure modes, and intronic polyadenylation govern gene expression.

ranked.headline: Bias-corrected models for biological age estimation and disease risk prediction
ranked.summary: Preprints and a publication address systematic bias in age clocks and disease-risk models, adding explicit correction and formal probabilistic structure.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-based methods refine archaic introgression and polygenic selection inference
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend haplotype-level inference of introgression, selection, and pedigree structure from genomic and pooled sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose method limits for inferring cellular dynamics from noisy, indirect data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test how well lineage, RNA velocity, and diffusion methods recover dynamics from noisy, simulated, or single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Inverse-design frameworks target switching proteins, disordered proteins and circuits
ranked.summary: Design objectives are being coupled to parameter-space analysis and certified parameter-interval methods across proteins and regulatory circuits.

ranked.headline: Long-read isoform models now linked to proteomic readouts for protein-level evidence
ranked.summary: Long-read RNA-seq now resolves isoforms that can be tested directly against peptide-level mass spectrometry evidence in new pipelines and tools.
